facts.why: Stock year field prints the release year on a 1973 hotel card, right under the sign 'Sunset Strip, Los Angeles, 1973', so it reads as the hotel's year. The story is set in 1973.

The label sits on the still of Penny alone in a hotel suite with a bottle. Movie-locations places William's LA stay at the Hyatt and Penny's overdose at the Plaza in New York; no source I opened says this Penny scene is at the Hyatt, so the label may name the wrong hotel. The writer had the same doubt.

notes: 'Don't take drugs!', soy cutlets, Anita's banned-food list, 'friendship is the booze they feed you', Band Aids, 'Rockstars have kidnapped my son', 'I am the enemy' all on Wikiquote. Golden god at the Topeka party house, $35 assignment, Black Sabbath, poker game, plane storm, Morocco on Wikipedia. '50 bucks and a case of beer' and 'What kind of beer?' on Shmoop. Continental Hyatt House (Riot House) as William's LA hotel on movie-locations.

vibe.verdict: The Riot House card with Elaine's 'Don't take drugs!', golden god burgers and Penny's case of beer feels like the tour, but the front is the poster plus a second title block, and the footer is stuffed with winks that read like a list.

Swap the footer winks 'Penny traded in a poker game. The storm on the charter plane.' for 'It's all happening.' (Dick Roswell, Wikiquote)
